name: All I need is you
source:
Alex and his Fiancé John are separated for the weekend because of John's job, but when something devastating happens, will they be able to get to each other before it's too late?

[From [url=https://xone101.itch.io/all-i-need-is-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亚历克斯和他的未婚夫约翰因为约翰的工作而在周末分开，但当灾难性的事情发生时，他们能在为时已晚之前联系到对方吗？

[来自[url=https://xone101.itch.io/all-i-need-is-you]Itch.io[/url]]
